# Warcraft 3
## What does randomization do to this game?
Items you can find give you:
* Unit unlocks (including workers)
* Upgrade unlocks
* Increases to your hero's level cap
* Mercenaries hireable from mercenary camps
* Items your hero can pick up

Locations include:
* Winning missions
* Completing quest objectives
* Killing enemy heroes the first time
* Picking up items dropped by enemies
* Buying locations from Goblin Merchants, Mercenary Camps, and Goblin Laboratories
* Destroying enemy bases
* Rescuing units
* Finding secrets
<!-- * Completing challenges -->

There are additional changes and randomizations that don't interface with the multiworld:
* Hero classes can changed or randomized
* Mercenaries available from mercenary camps may be randomized
* An option allows adding additional mercenary camps to missions that did not have them in vanilla

## What is the goal of this game when randomized?
The goal is to beat the final mission of the final campaign you have enabled in your options.

## What non-randomized changes are there from vanilla?
This mod primarily uses Frozen Throne (TFT) balance, to enable acquiring TFT heroes, units, and items
in the Reign of Chaos (RoC) campaign.
This means casters will have Magic attack type instead of Piercing,
heroes will have Hero attack type instead of Normal,
siege units have their TFT models
and various unit stats are adjusted from vanilla.

Note creep gold amounts have been adjusted to their Reign of Chaos values for balance reasons.

# Warcraft 3 Archipelago Setup Guide
There are two components to the Warcraft 3 Archipelago randomizer, the apworld client and the map files.

## APworld setup
Get the .apworld file, and place it in your Archipelago installation in the custom_worlds/ folder.

You should then be able to generate a multiworld containing Warcraft 3 yamls, and launch the client.
The client can be launched either from the generic Archipelago launcher, or from

## Mod setup
Download the map files from the release page on github.
Place them in the following folder: `<user>/Documents/Warcraft III/Maps/Archipelago`.

The maps should now appear under the Archipelago/ folder in the "Custom Game" menu within Warcraft 3.
The subfolder is necessary to have the next mission automatically start after beating the previous one.

## Playing the game
Simply open Warcraft 3 and launch any Archipelago map as a custom game
while the Archipelago client is running.
If the Archipelago client is not running, the game will display an error message
that it could not establish a connection.
The game will still be playable, but your progress will not be saved, locations will not be collected,
and unlocks will not work.

# war3-ap-maps
A repository containing map data for Archipelago Warcraft 3, along with tools to deal with Warcraft 3 file formats.

## Licensing
The original campaign maps are property of Blizzard Entertainment, used per their license at [license/Blizzard.LICENSE](license/Blizzard.LICENSE).

Tools used to handle warcraft 3 files are under the MIT License, included at [license/LICENSE](license/LICENSE)

## AI disclosure
AI was not used or consulted in any way while working on this project.

## Development
### Example workspace.ini file:
```ini
wc3_path=D:\war3_1304\Warcraft III\Warcraft III.exe
mpqeditor_path=C:\Tools\mpqeditor\x64\MPQEditor.exe

verbose=true

# general
map_file=test_dalaran_ruins
map_format=w3x

# extract
extract_source=./scratch
extract_file=${extract_source}/${map_file}.${map_format}
extract_dir=./extract

# pack
pack_source=${extract_dir}/${map_file}
pack_out_dir=./pack
pack_ext=${map_format}

# gamecache
```

notes.text:
### 0.0.2 -- Undead Campaign release
This is the second release of Archipelago Warcraft 3, featuring the Undead campaign. The Human campaign can be played in combination with the Undead campaign, or each can be played separately. Additionally, the night elf and tavern heroes that were unavailable to play in 0.0.1 are now included.

Note worlds generated with the 0.0.1 apworld should be compatible with the 0.0.2 client.

### Installation instructions
* archipelago.w3n should be placed in the Documents/Warcraft III/Campaigns folder
* wc3.apworld should be installed with your existing Archipelago installation, either by putting it in custom_worlds/ or installing it through the launcher
* The template yaml is provided for your convenience, and also because I believe the template generated by the Archipelago launcher doesn't give the best introduction to yaml. It is formatted slightly differently, but has all the same options
* To start playing, launch the warcraft 3 AP client and then separately launch warcraft 3 the game and go to custom campaigns -> Archipelago
* If playing on 1.29, make sure you update the registry key
  * **Windows**: Run `/setup` through the ap client on Windows
  * **Linux**: Run regedit through the same Wine prefix (`drive_c/windows/regedit.exe`)
    * Navigate to key `HKEY_CURRENT_USER\SOFTWARE\Blizzard Entertainment\Warcraft III`
      * If this folder doesn't already exist, make sure you've already run Warcraft 3 for the first time so it creates it
    * Add a DWORD key `Allow Local Files`
    * Set the value of `Allow Local Files` to 1

### Game versions
* Reforged / current release Warcraft 3 is not supported
* If you have the game through battle.net, install 1.29 using the dropdown right above the play button in the battle.net launcher
* If you have your old CD keys, you can install version 1.29 or version 1.30 from The Hive and use your CD keys on that installation

### Known issues
If you've installed and played 0.0.1 before, when first launching the 0.0.2 client it will warn you of a version mismatch. So long as you've installed 0.0.2 correctly, this should go away and doesn't flag any significant issue.

### Mod versions
* apworld release ID: 2
* mod release ID: 4
